component: Profile, address-book and calendar import recovery buttons

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: When an in-progress import fails, showError removes progress state, enables Back and disables the .before-progress Start Import button. Profile, address-book and calendar summary builders enable that button again. Keep the failure state and summary reconstruction paired when changing retry navigation. This describes the controller code, not a tested retry or accessibility result.
title: Importer failure disables Start Import until the summary is rebuilt
